description:
In this video I'm sharing the exact behaviors that make you a rookie, average, or pro-level communicator. 

PREORDER MY NEW BOOK: https://vinhgiang.com/before-we-forget-how-to-connect

FREE CommunicationTraining ➡ https://free.vinhgiang.com/rvavp-frameworks
I'll teach you 3 communication frameworks to master conversations 🗣️

STAGE Academy (my online course) ➡ https://free.vinhgiang.com/rvavp-stage-academy

If there's one thing I've learned over the last 15 years of being a communication skills teacher, keynote speaker, and entrepreneur, it's that communication is the most valuable asset you can directly control that creates more trust, authority and growth in your career and life. Because the quality of your life is the quality of your communication (cheesy I know lol) 

So I'll be breaking down the exact behaviors of some of the top communicators in the world and also some of the worst communicators in the world so that you know exactly how to level up to become a natural communicator. Trust me it's not as hard as you think. Everything you're learning in this video is just a series of behaviors that you can practice to help you become more natural as a communicator.

=== About Vinh Giang ===
Vinh Giang is an internationally acclaimed keynote speaker, communication skills expert, and magician. He blends his unique talents to captivate audiences and deliver powerful lessons on the art of influence, persuasion, and effective communication. His mission is to empower individuals and leaders to communicate with clarity, confidence, and impact, enabling them to unlock new levels of success in both their personal and professional lives.
